name: wikitext2-MIA-Benchmark
description: A benchmark dataset for evaluating membership inference attacks (MIA) on language models using the WikiText-2 corpus. It provides queries, model responses, and attack labels/scores to measure how easily models leak training-set membership. The benchmark supports systematic comparison of attack methods and defenses for privacy evaluation.
evaluation_method: ROC AUC (attack ROC AUC) and attack accuracy (attack success rate)
reputation: A niche research benchmark used by privacy and security researchers studying membership inference; moderate adoption within that community.
